=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2984-3015 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_skip_release_token` reads the existing `_unparked` marker only when the release reason is `expired|revoked_idle`. A `revoked_no_head_gate` release on a marker head therefore writes the plain reason. `_merge_lease_skips_normalize` (2918-2924) then keeps that newest entry for the `pr:head`, which overwrites the marker. On the next grant, `_merge_lease_skip_block` (3310-3318) drops the entry because it has no keep arm for `revoked_no_head_gate`. The release appends at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2132-2138 and 2439-2445 write these entries.
  WHY: Each head-gate failure followed by a success on the same head (for example, a cancelled review that is re-run) resets the once-per-head budget, so a PR can be un-parked again and again on an unchanged head. This breaks issue G2 ("un-parked this way at most once per head"), and no test covers this sequence. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2488-2493 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`, the holder-filter awk command substitution ends in `|| true`. If awk fails, `tm_queue_skips` is set to empty, which discards every hard skip entry before `_merge_lease_queue_first` runs.
  WHY: This fails open in the unsafe direction: waiters parked by `revoked_draft`, `revoked_final_ci_failed`, `revoked_skip_ai` or `*_unparked` can be granted on an unchanged head. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT because an awk failure is unlikely.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G2: "such an entry is un-parked this way at most once per head: when the same head is released again with the same reason, the new entry is hard until the head changes. Record that in the entry ... so the rule needs no extra state."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_skip_release_token` and `_merge_lease_skip_block`; tests/test_merge_lease.py SoftSkipEntries (next to `test_a_head_released_again_after_its_unpark_stays_hard`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `_merge_lease_skip_release_token` (pr_checks_lib.sh:2988-3001) keeps the `_unparked` marker only for `expired`/`revoked_idle` releases, `_merge_lease_skip_block` does not keep a `revoked_no_head_gate` entry as a marker, `test_a_head_released_again_after_its_unpark_stays_hard` only cycles `expired`/`revoked_idle` re-releases, `test_classifier_soft_and_hard_sets` does not exercise the release-token path for `revoked_no_head_gate` on a marker head, and no test releases a marker head as `revoked_no_head_gate`, re-grants it on head-gate success, and then asserts that a later `expired`/`revoked_idle` release on the same head is hard.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2985-3002, 3312-3313, 2918-2924 (with scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2064, 2134-2135, 2387, 2441-2442) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The once-per-head `_unparked` marker survives a later release only when that release is `expired` or `revoked_idle`. On a `revoked_no_head_gate` release, `_merge_lease_skip_release_token` returns the plain token and normalize replaces `N:H:expired_unparked`. `_merge_lease_skip_block` then drops the entry on re-grant without keeping a marker, so the next `expired`/`revoked_idle` release writes the plain soft reason again.
  WHY: Every head-gate failure followed by a success on the same head resets the budget, so a PR can cycle through the lease on an unchanged head with no upper bound. This breaks G2 and contradicts the README, agents.d and changelog. The tests miss it. Suggested fix: add a soft `revoked_no_head_gate_unparked` token, rewrite it to `expired_unparked` in `_merge_lease_skip_block`, and add a test.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2490-2493 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`, the holder-filter awk ends in `|| true`, so an awk failure empties the hard-skip list.
  WHY: Parked waiters (`revoked_draft`, `revoked_final_ci_failed`, `revoked_skip_ai`, `*_unparked`) can be granted on an unchanged head, which fails open. Suggested fix: assign the result only when awk exits 0.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: G2: "To keep one PR from cycling through the lease, such an entry is un-parked this way at most once per head: when the same head is released again with the same reason, the new entry is hard until the head changes. Record that in the entry ... so the rule needs no extra state."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _merge_lease_skip_release_token and _merge_lease_skip_block; tests/test_merge_lease.py, next to test_a_head_released_again_after_its_unpark_stays_hard.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk keeps the `_unparked` marker across a `revoked_no_head_gate` release. No test covers the sequence: release as revoked_no_head_gate, re-grant, release as expired, which must come out hard.
- HARDENING (2 related items): the same awk fail-open fix (3 lines) and the `revoked_no_head_gate)` arm returning `revoked_no_head_gate_unparked` (8 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh (function `_merge_lease_skip_release_token`, added near lines 2993-3015) and the release append at scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_tick` lines ~2132-2138 and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` lines ~2439-2442 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Only `expired|revoked_idle` consult the `_unparked` marker. A `revoked_no_head_gate` release falls through to the plain `printf`, normalize overwrites the marker, and `_merge_lease_skip_block`'s keep-set (`expired|revoked_idle|expired_unparked|revoked_idle_unparked`) drops the entry.
  WHY: The sequence expired → grant keeps marker → revoked_no_head_gate overwrites it → grant drops it → expired writes the plain reason lets the cycle repeat, which defeats G2. Every cancelled review re-arms an un-park.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh (function `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`, holder-filter awk around lines 2488-2493) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `|| true` swallows an awk failure and leaves `tm_queue_skips` empty.
  WHY: Parked waiters can be granted on an unchanged head, which fails open. The probability is low.

  Requirement: G2 of issue #10044: "such an entry is un-parked this way at most once per head: when the same head is released again with the same reason, the new entry is hard until the head changes. Record that in the entry (a fourth field or a distinct reason token; the plan picks one) so the rule needs no extra state."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_skip_release_token`; tests/test_merge_lease.py SoftSkipEntries.
  Evidence of absence: Only `expired`/`revoked_idle` re-releases preserve the marker. There is no test for a `revoked_no_head_gate` release on a marker head followed by `expired`. `test_a_head_released_again_after_its_unpark_stays_hard` and `test_classifier_soft_and_hard_sets` do not exercise this path.
